info.title: aiscast API
info.description:
Live AIS data from openwaters.io: current vessel positions, receiving-station statistics, usage stats, self-serve tokens, and HTTP ingest for feeders. All responses are JSON, CORS is open, and times are UTC. JSON responses are compressed (zstd or gzip) when the request sends Accept-Encoding.

The streaming endpoints are not described here: `/v0/stream` (WebSocket, aisstream.io-compatible), `/v1/stream` (WebSocket or Server-Sent Events, both directions), `/v1/nmea` (WebSocket, raw NMEA back to feeders), and raw NMEA ingest on UDP port 10110. See [docs/API.md](https://github.com/openwatersio/aiscast/blob/main/docs/API.md) for those.

tags.name: Data
tags.description: Current vessels, stations, and usage statistics. No token needed. 120 requests per minute per address.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Self-serve personal tokens. The operator mints feeder, peer, partner, and admin tokens offline.

get.description: One `Point` feature per vessel with a known position, seen within the last 30 minutes. Filter with `bbox` and/or `mmsi` (ORed together), or neither for all vessels. Properties use AIS "not available" sentinels by omission: `cog`, `sog`, `heading`, `nav_status`, `name`, and `type` are present only when known.

Every station heard since the server started. `events` counts decoded messages credited to the station (first to deliver them) over rolling 24-hour and 7-day windows. `vessels` is distinct MMSIs heard in the last 30 minutes. `bbox` is the extent of positions heard, a rough coverage footprint. Volunteer UDP stations appear as a keyed hash, never an address.

get.summary: One station with the vessels it last updated
get.description: The station's statistics row plus a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the vessels whose latest message came from this station. Station ids can contain slashes (`kystverket/2573010`).

A one-shot summary for status pages and tracking growth: stations, vessels, event rates, client counts, and per-source-kind breakdowns. Counts are rolling windows over the last 24 hours and 7 days (hourly buckets, kept across restarts), never since-start totals.

post.summary: Mint a personal token for a device key
post.description: Self-serve tokens for an Ed25519 device key. Personal tokens never expire and allow 2 concurrent streams, 50 messages/s per stream, 400 square degrees of subscribed area, and publishing. A personal token whose stations delivered at least 1,000 events in the last 24 hours is treated as the feeder tier (5 streams, 200 messages/s, no area cap, `/v1/nmea` access) while the station keeps feeding. `bind_ip: true` adds the requester's address as a `cidr` claim so a UDP station at that address counts toward this token's feeder tier (the token then only works from that address). 10 requests per minute per address: one token is all a client needs.

bind_ip.description: Also bind the requester's address, so its UDP station counts as this token's.

200.description: The token and the claims it carries.

token.description: Ed25519-signed claim token, `ak1.<base64url claims>.<base64url signature>`, about 200 characters.

400.description: Malformed JSON, or `pubkey` is not a base64url Ed25519 public key.

501.description: This server has no personal-token issuer configured.

post.description: AIS-catcher's HTTP output: `AIS-catcher -H https://ais.openwaters.io/v1/receive USERPWD x:<token> GZIP on INTERVAL 15`. Body is either AIS-catcher's `jsonaiscatcher` envelope or plain newline-separated NMEA. `Content-Encoding: gzip` is accepted, with a 1 MB limit before and after decompression. Needs a token that may publish (`personal`, `feeder`, `peer`, or `admin`). The token's `sub` becomes the station. 600 posts per minute per station. Every response carries a `Link: rel="terms-of-service"` header naming the contributor agreement; feeding data is acceptance.

rxtime.description: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS UTC; used as the message time when within 30 s of arrival.

schema.description: Newline-separated NMEA sentences, TAG blocks allowed.

413.description: Body larger than 1 MB (before or after gzip decompression).

get.summary: Raw deduplicated NMEA back to feeders (WebSocket)
get.description: A WebSocket endpoint: one text frame per deduplicated message, each sentence prefixed with a NMEA 4.10 TAG block carrying the station (`s:`), the canonical time (`c:`), and the source's license tag (`t:`). Needs a token with role `feeder`, `peer`, `partner`, or `admin`, or a personal token that has earned the feeder tier by contributing. Optional `bbox` filters by the vessel's last known position. The stream itself is outside this document; see [docs/API.md](https://github.com/openwatersio/aiscast/blob/main/docs/API.md). The responses below are what a request receives when it is refused before the WebSocket upgrade.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: `minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon`. Repeatable; boxes are ORed. Must fit inside the token's `bbox` and `area` claims.

get.description: `ok` while data flows. 503 when the server's own loopback subscriber has received nothing for two minutes, i.e. the stream itself delivers no events. A single silent source is not an outage while the others keep the stream flowing; per-source ages are in `/metrics`.

text/plain.example: no events delivered to subscribers for 3m20s

200.description: The OpenAPI description of this server.

token.description: An aiscast claim token (`ak1....`), minted by `POST /v1/keys` or by the operator. Besides `Authorization: Bearer`, the token is accepted as an HTTP Basic password (`anything:<token>`, which is what AIS-catcher's USERPWD sends) or as `?key=<token>` on the URL. A token that is present but invalid, expired, revoked, used outside its `cidr`, or lacking the role for the action is refused; it never degrades to anonymous access.

mmsi.name: mmsi
mmsi.description: Comma-separated MMSIs. ORed with `bbox` when both are given; unparseable entries are dropped.

BadRequest.description: Malformed parameter or body. The plain-text body says which.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked token, or the token lacks the role for this action. The plain-text body gives the reason.

RateLimited.description: Over the per-address or per-station request limit.

VesselFeature.description: One vessel with a known position, seen within the last 30 minutes.

type.description: AIS ship/cargo code, or AtoN type. Present only when known.

cog.description: Course over ground, degrees. Present only when known.

sog.description: Speed over ground, knots. Present only when known.

heading.description: True heading, degrees. Present only when known.

nav_status.description: AIS navigational status. Present only when known.

seen.description: Time of the last message that updated the vessel.

source.description: Source of that message: an upstream name, `http:<station>`, `udp:<hash>`, `mmsi:<n>`, or `v1:<sub>`.

msg_type.description: aisstream-style type name of that message.

station.description: Station id. Volunteer UDP stations are a keyed hash of the sender, never an address.

duplicates.description: Messages another station delivered first, since this station was first heard after the last restart.

vessels.description: Distinct MMSIs heard in the last 30 minutes.

positions.description: Position messages since first heard after the last restart.

bbox.description: `[minLat, minLon, maxLat, maxLon]` extent of positions heard, a rough coverage footprint. Absent until a position has been heard.

Windows.description: A rolling counter: hourly buckets, kept across restarts.

total.description: Stations heard since the server started.

active.description: Stations heard in the last 5 minutes.

by_source.description: Station counts grouped by source kind: `udp`, `http`, `v1`, `mmsi`, or the upstream name.

per_second.description: Deduplicated event rate over the last 30 s.

sources.description: Keyed by source kind: each upstream by name, all API publishers as `v1`, all UDP senders as `udp`, all HTTP feeders as `http`.

last_age_s.description: Seconds since any member last produced an event.

vessels.description: Distinct MMSIs heard in the last 30 minutes.

vessels_exclusive.description: Of those, MMSIs no other source kind heard in that window.

Claims.description: The claims a token carries. Absent limits mean unlimited.

sub.description: Who: a station name, partner name, or `ed25519:<pubkey>` / `mmsi:<n>` for a device.

exp.description: Expiry, unix seconds. Absent on personal tokens, which never expire.

bbox.description: Boxes every subscription must fit inside, each `[minLat, minLon, maxLat, maxLon]`.

cidr.description: Source CIDRs/IPs the token may be used from.

rate.description: Messages per second per connection; excess is thinned.

area.description: Total subscribed bounding-box area in square degrees. Negative means MMSI-only subscriptions.

mmsis.description: Vessels followed by MMSI per subscription.
